commands:
set -eu
TREE=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomap/worktrees/prod-loader-artwork-pr65-20261101
KEY=/Users/michal/.ssh/id_ed25519
PI=michal@192.168.0.23
REMOTE=/home/michal/src/PhotoMaps/frontend/dist
INDEX_SHA=81a61c28810e1acd90a69056b87775d261bbd120cc6587fb6f8c3fee6cc1b4fa
test "$(git -C "$TREE" rev-parse HEAD)" = deaa562cdeaffff0b14beafa2a2bd1a128bf38fe
test "$(shasum -a 256 "$TREE/frontend/dist/index.html" | awk '{print $1}')" = "$INDEX_SHA"
test -f "$TREE/frontend/dist/assets/public-map-Bh9Dah7-.js"
test -f "$TREE/frontend/dist/assets/index-WJR2wAcC.css"
export RSYNC_RSH="ssh -i $KEY -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8"
rsync -az --exclude=index.html "$TREE/frontend/dist/" "$PI:$REMOTE/"
rsync -az "$TREE/frontend/dist/index.html" "$PI:$REMOTE/index.html.next"
ssh -i "$KEY" -o BatchMode=yes -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o ConnectTimeout=8 "$PI" '
set -eu
cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps
BACKUP=.dev/deploy/2026-11-01-loader-artwork-pr65-deaa562
test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = deaa562cdeaffff0b14beafa2a2bd1a128bf38fe
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
test -s "$BACKUP/dist-before/index.html"
test -s "$BACKUP/app-before.db"
test "$(cat "$BACKUP/backend-pid-before")" = 2765142
test "$(cat "$BACKUP/tunnel-pid-before")" = 222848
test -f frontend/dist/assets/public-map-Bh9Dah7-.js
test -f frontend/dist/assets/index-WJR2wAcC.css
sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html.next | grep -q 81a61c28810e1acd90a69056b87775d261bbd120cc6587fb6f8c3fee6cc1b4fa
systemctl is-active --quiet photomap.service
systemctl is-active --quiet cloudflared.service
test "$(systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID --value)" = 2765142
test "$(systemctl show cloudflared.service -p MainPID --value)" = 222848
rollback_index() {
  echo "===PRODUCTION_RELEASE_CHECK_FAILED_RESTORING_INDEX==="
  cp -p "$BACKUP/dist-before/index.html" frontend/dist/index.html.rollback
  mv -f frontend/dist/index.html.rollback frontend/dist/index.html
}
mv -f frontend/dist/index.html.next frontend/dist/index.html
if ! sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html | grep -q 81a61c28810e1acd90a69056b87775d261bbd120cc6587fb6f8c3fee6cc1b4fa; then rollback_index; exit 1; fi
for ENDPOINT in / /health /api/places/map /assets/public-map-Bh9Dah7-.js /assets/index-WJR2wAcC.css; do
 CODE=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 20 "http://127.0.0.1:8000$ENDPOINT") || { rollback_index; exit 1; }
 echo "PI_HTTP $ENDPOINT $CODE"
 if [ "$CODE" != 200 ]; then rollback_index; exit 1; fi
done
if ! systemctl is-active --quiet photomap.service || ! systemctl is-active --quiet cloudflared.service; then rollback_index; exit 1; fi
if [ "$(systemctl show photomap.service -p MainPID --value)" != 2765142 ]; then rollback_index; exit 1; fi
if [ "$(systemctl show cloudflared.service -p MainPID --value)" != 222848 ]; then rollback_index; exit 1; fi
printf "PI_ACTIVE_INDEX_SHA="; sha256sum frontend/dist/index.html
free -k
echo ===PI_PR65_ATOMIC_FRONTEND_DEPLOY_PASS_NO_RESTART===
'
for ENDPOINT in / /health /api/places/map /assets/public-map-Bh9Dah7-.js /assets/index-WJR2wAcC.css; do
 CODE=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 25 "https://photomap.pl$ENDPOINT")
 echo "PUBLIC_HTTP $ENDPOINT $CODE"
 test "$CODE" = 200
done
for URL in https://photomap.pl/ 'https://photomap.pl/?release=deaa562'; do
 HTML=$(curl -fsSL -H 'Cache-Control: no-cache' --max-time 25 "$URL")
 if printf '%s' "$HTML" | grep -Fq /assets/public-map-Bh9Dah7-.js; then
   echo "PUBLIC_NEW_ASSET_IN_HTML_PASS URL=$URL"
 else
   echo "PUBLIC_NEW_ASSET_IN_HTML_MISSING URL=$URL"
   exit 1
 fi
done
echo ===PR65_PUBLIC_PRODUCTION_RELEASE_PASS===
